mentions.name: pg-restic
mentions.description: pg-restic is a small Docker container that backs up Postgres databases to S3, B2, or any S3-compatible storage using restic. It runs pg_dumpall on a cron schedule and streams the dump directly into a restic repository so nothing touches local disk. It produces encrypted, deduplicated snapshots with retention policies and daily pruning, and no snapshot is saved if a dump fails. It ships pg_dumpall 18, supporting Postgres versions from 9.2 to 18.
mentions.problem: Existing Postgres backup Docker images shipped an older pg_dump that couldn't back up newer Postgres versions.
mentions.source_excerpt: pg-restic – Postgres backups to S3/B2 (or any S3-compatible storage) using restic, in one small Docker container.
mentions.author: sriramiyer
